name: Pedro Corgnati
bio: Pedro Corgnati is the founder of SystemForge and a full-stack developer with over 5 years of experience. Specialized in Next.js, TypeScript, and SaaS architecture, he leads projects from MVP to production — with a focus on code quality, complete documentation, and on-time delivery. With direct experience in international markets, he builds solutions for clients in Brazil, Italy, and the US.
